workstreams.title: Portable ownership and embedding
workstreams.obligation: Explicit allocation, bounded resources, checked handles, C lifecycle, and replayable host interaction.

workstreams.title: Conformance and evidence
workstreams.obligation: Pinned corpora, real runners, inspectable pipeline output, independent qualification, fuzzing, and failure minimization.

workstreams.title: HTML and DOM
workstreams.obligation: Specified parsing and recovery, document identity, tree mutation, events, custom elements, and shadow DOM.

workstreams.title: CSS and layout
workstreams.obligation: Cascade, selectors, all declared layout families, fragmentation, animation, and incremental equivalence.

workstreams.title: Text and fonts
workstreams.obligation: Unicode, OpenType, fallback, shaping, rasterization, caret movement, and selection across scripts.

workstreams.title: Zig-native JavaScript
workstreams.obligation: Language semantics, objects, collector, modules, RegExp, BigInt, Intl, adaptive execution, and native specialization.

workstreams.title: Paint and media
workstreams.obligation: Software raster, images, SVG, canvas, internal GPU backend, audio/video, and decoder safety.

workstreams.title: Web platform services
workstreams.obligation: URL, encoding, Fetch, storage, workers, service workers, streams, cryptography, and origin behavior.

workstreams.title: Guest graphics and compute
workstreams.obligation: WebAssembly, WebGL, WebGPU, and related API qualification, separate from internal acceleration.

workstreams.title: Broker and containment
workstreams.obligation: Independent authorization, process isolation, resource limits, origin policy, and hostile-input containment.

workstreams.title: Minimal native browser
workstreams.obligation: Address bar, page, navigation, application windows, permissions, persistence, downloads, and diagnostics, in a Rust shell with engine-rendered chrome that uses only the public embedding contract.

workstreams.title: Input and accessibility
workstreams.obligation: IME, keyboard, pointer, touch, focus, selection, platform accessibility, zoom, and printing.

workstreams.title: Cross-platform execution
workstreams.obligation: Windows, Linux, macOS, WebAssembly embedding, architecture variants, and later mobile lifecycle qualification.

workstreams.title: Idiomatic language integration
workstreams.obligation: The first-party Rust wrapper, qualified first and used by the browser shell, followed by qualified ownership, errors, cancellation, and runtime behavior across the published language adapter contract. Each officially supported language SDK powers a maintained first-party Fairpane integration and a useful reference extension.

workstreams.title: Extensions
workstreams.obligation: One extension contract and permission broker, equal-capability clients in JavaScript on Fairpane's own runtime and every officially supported language SDK, isolated extension workers, enforceable resource policy, executable parity scenarios, and separately qualified compatibility with existing browser extensions.

workstreams.title: Open development and adoption
workstreams.obligation: License, provenance, releases, security response, governance, documentation, and downstream adoption.
